definitions.explanation: The four corner points of a rectangular or square object, room, or area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{四隅|よすみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I cleaned the four corners of the room.

examples.japanese: テーブルクロス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{四隅|よすみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}さえて→押さえる：02021_osaeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please hold down the four corners of the tablecloth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運動場|うんどうじょう}→運動場：21813_undoujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{四隅|よすみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦コーン→コーン：28894_koon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{置|お}かれている→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: Cones are placed at the four corners of the playing field.

notes:
{四隅|よすみ} refers to the four corners of any rectangular or square space or object.

PRONUNCIATION:
The {四|よ} is a native Japanese (kun'yomi) reading, as in {四|よ}つ. The on'yomi compound {四隅|しぐう} does not exist — {四隅|よすみ} is the standard form.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {四隅|よすみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: at the four corners
- {四隅|よすみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧: the four corners (as object)
- {四隅|よすみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to place at the four corners

Typically used for rooms, tables, pages, fields, envelopes, and other rectangular spaces.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{隅|すみ}→隅：01625_sumi⟧: corner (single)
- ⟦{角|かど}→角：02195_kado⟧: corner, edge (of a building or street)
